$comment: Machine-readable inventory of the Ubiquitous Maniacs import. Records PROVENANCE ONLY: what was imported, from where, with which hash. It selects no licence, approves nothing, and asserts no canon. The migration map (MIGRATION_MAP.md) is the human readable account of where each unit lands.
$imported_convention: Real-world metadata date. AGENTS.md section 6 limits in-world future dates to 20XX; this file makes no in-world claims, so a real date here does not violate that rule.

source.relationship: Separate repository. This corpus was developed there and is imported here as a source-of-record; it is not tracked by any automated sync.

licence_status.note: The source repository contains no LICENSE, COPYING or equivalent file for this corpus, and no licence grant travels with the material. The imported files are therefore preserved as the author's own prior work, and the repository's own licence decisions (AUTHOR_DECISION_QUEUE rows D10 and D16) remain open and untouched by this import.

locally_annotated.detail: A banner was prepended marking the file as archived material that is not in force, and naming the repository-root AGENTS.md as the authority. The corpus's text below the banner is unchanged. The upstream blob sha in this manifest is the original file's, so the difference between it and the local sha256 is exactly this banner.

missing_upstream.detail: The corpus README names `data/lab_people.csv` and `data/lab_relationships.csv` as the people and relationship data, and `app.py` loads them at runtime. The directory was never committed to the source repository, so the import cannot include it and the Streamlit app in this archive cannot run as shipped.
